children: Jaguar Health called a special meeting of stockholders that was convened but lacked a quorum, so no votes were taken.
The special meeting was called and convened on September 4, 2026, but insufficient shares were present or represented by proxy to constitute a quorum.
No proposal from the Schedule 14A definitive proxy statement filed August 3, 2026, was voted on and no business was conducted.
Jaguar Health will not adjourn or reconvene this meeting and may evaluate calling a new special meeting in the future.
The filing includes forward-looking statements about potentially calling a new special meeting and cautions that outcomes are uncertain.
